name: Sit-and-rise test
rangeNote: A fitness test, so there is no lab range: your result is compared with people of your age and sex in published norm tables (shown on this page).
summary: Sit down on the floor and stand up again using as little support as you can. It scores, from 0 to 10, the strength, flexibility, balance and coordination needed for an everyday movement.

high.meaning: A higher score (fewer hands or knees used) means better strength, flexibility and balance together.

low.meaning: A lower score was linked to higher death rates in adults aged 51–80 in Brazilian studies. It depends on strength, flexibility, balance and body weight.
